answer: Proof of Stake serves as a digital oasis for resource-backed consensus, where validators stake assets to maintain network pulse. By requiring cryptographic capital commitment, the system ensures that spinning up identities is not a frictionless tundra of infinite fake accounts. An attacker faces a prohibitive financial cost proportional to their desired influence, as manipulating the state requires controlling a majority of the underlying stake, rendering Sybil attacks economically irrational.
